modules.module_title: Maintain safe and secure working environment

pcs.pc_description: identify hazardous activities and the possible causes of risks or accidents in the workplace
implement safe working practices while dealing with hazards to ensure safety of self and others
ensure that team is following appropriate safety practices while working in and around trenches, elevated places and confined areas
conduct regular checks of the machines with support of the maintenance team to identify potential hazards
organise safety drills or training sessions to create awareness amongst others on the identified risks and safety practices
fill daily check sheet to report improvements done and risks identified
ensure that relevant safety boards/signs are placed on the shop floor for the safety of self and others
report any identified breaches in health, safety and security policies and procedures to the designated person
ensure that team is following appropriate emergency procedures such as raising alarm, safe evacuation etc.
ensure team is aware about hygiene and sanitation regulations and following them on the shop floor
ensure workplace, equipment, restrooms etc. are cleaned and sanitized regularly
ensure availability of running water, hand wash and alcohol-based sanitizers at the workplace
report advanced hygiene and sanitation issues to appropriate authority
report regarding the contagious illness of self or people in close contact
implement appropriate housekeeping methods and practices at workplace
ensure good housekeeping in order to prevent hazards and accidents
monitor that that team is storing the material, tools and equipment in the correct location and in good condition after work completion
ensure recyclable, non-recyclable and hazardous wastes are segregated as per SOP
ensure proper mechanism is followed while collecting and disposing of non-recyclable, recyclable and reusable waste

modules.module_title: Implement material and energy conservation practices

pcs.pc_description: identify processes where material and energy/electricity utilization can be optimized
ensure malfunctioning (fumes/sparks/emission/vibration/noise) and lapse in maintenance of equipment are resolved effectively
prepare and analyze material and energy audit reports to decipher excessive consumption of material and water
identify possibilities of using renewable energy and environment friendly fuels

escalate problems to supervisors that cannot be handled
report the completed work

ensure that team is following responsible and disciplined behaviours at the workplace

modules.module_title: Preparing Safe Operating Practices for the plant/equipment operation

pcs.pc_description: Explain the basic operation of the plant with its safety/hazard implications
Develop the SOP along with the Operation & Maintenance team
Ensure standards personal protective types of equipment (PPE’s ) are used at the site as per relevant work
Check that all required signs are posted, and bulletin boards are maintained in clear and legible condition
Make daily observations of employees to ensure that work is performed safely

Monitor overall performance of subordinates on the designed measures to ensure quality

Train workers about hazards, methods to prevent harm, and the OHS standards that apply to the workplace so they can perform their work safely
Carry out special toolbox talks which require discussion on highly critical safety related matters, hazardous site conditions pertaining to particular work etc
Keep records of training indicating the names, identity numbers and job description of trainees etc

modules.module_title: Inspect the tools, tackles, equipment, vehicles etc.

pcs.pc_description: Explain the working operation of each item of inspection
Check the workability of each against the designed capability & specifications according to the schedule defined in the plant
Record relevant data from the inspection to check compliance & log results
Explain the basic process and the associated safety hazards
Stop any unsafe practice, arrange to remove any hazardous material & advise the concerned worker about the risk associated
Log the observations, make a report and submit to concerned authority
Ensure adherence to the organizational policies and procedures for all relevant plant activities by the workmen subordinations

pcs.pc_description: Follow defined Safety Audit procedure appropriate for the particular plant, according to the frequency defined in the plant.
Inspect any unsafe conditions in the plant
Make a formal report and log on to system or submit to the concerned authority
